100 Years Ago Today, This is What Was Happening ...

On August 18, 1926, the world witnessed significant developments as the League of Nations convened to address ongoing tensions in Europe, particularly regarding the situation in Germany. Meanwhile, in the realm of aviation, famed pilot Charles Lindbergh announced plans for a transatlantic flight to South America, igniting excitement in the aviation community. In entertainment, the silent film industry continued its dominance, with box office hits captivating audiences across the nation.
